description: Run the customs declaration rule pack over a declaration ledger and return the findings as a Markdown report. The input is a JSON or YAML table: one row per document line, with columns such as 品名 (description), 商品编号 (HS code), 币制 (currency), 毛重/净重 (gross/net weight), 申报日期 (declaration date) and 总价 (total value). Call customs_schema for the exact field names and their aliases. The report lists only literal differences from the declared checks — an HS code that is not ten digits, a currency that is not a 3-letter code, gross weight below net weight, a duplicated document number, a date that does not parse or is in the future, an unfilled placeholder. Each finding carries the clause it rests on, or states that the clause text was not obtained. It does NOT decide whether a declaration is correct, whether goods are misclassified, or whether duty is owed. It performs no writes and needs no credentials. Read the "未执行的检查" (checks not executed) section at the end: it names every rule that did not run and why, and a report is only as complete as that list allows.

material.description: The ledger as JSON or YAML text. Either an object with a `rows` array, or a bare array of row objects.

onlyRules.description: Run only these rule ids, e.g. ["CD-002"]. Omit to run the whole pack.

name: customs_check
title: Check a declaration ledger for internal inconsistency
